title: MITHRAS CANADA Jadau Lotus Pendant Invisible Chain Necklace
full_title: MITHRAS CANADA Jadau Lotus Pendant Invisible Chain Necklace | Gold-Tone Setting, Pearl Accents, Multi colour Kundans, Ethnic Indian Style
bullets: JADAU LOTUS PENDANT: Features a stunning lotus-shaped centrepiece adorned with vibrant pink and green kundan stones, accented by lustrous white pearls.
INVISIBLE CHAIN DESIGN: Suspended on a delicate gold-toned invisible chain with a secure hook clasp closure and an adjustable extender link.
INTRICATE DETAILING: The necklace showcases five decorative charms along the chain, each set with coloured stones and cascading pearl clusters.
TRADITIONAL CRAFTSMANSHIP: Inspired by classic Indian Jadau jewellery techniques, blending rich gold-toned metalwork with vivid gemstone-style embellishments.
VERSATILE OCCASION WEAR: Pairs beautifully with sarees, lehengas, and ethnic ensembles, making it ideal for weddings, festivals, and celebrations.
description: Elevate your ethnic ensemble with the MITHRAS CANADA Jadau Lotus Pendant Necklace, a stunning piece of traditional Indian jewellery that beautifully blends heritage craftsmanship with timeless elegance. The centrepiece features an intricately designed lotus motif adorned with vibrant pink and emerald green stones, accented by sparkling kundan-style embellishments and delicate pearl clusters that cascade gracefully around the pendant. Four additional charms — two featuring pink stones and two with green stones — are symmetrically arranged along the sleek gold-toned invisible chain, each adorned with lustrous pearl drops that add a refined, feminine touch. The necklace fastens with a secure hook clasp and includes an adjustable extender for a comfortable, customised fit. This exquisite piece pairs beautifully with sarees, lehengas, and other traditional Indian attire, making it an ideal choice for weddings, festivals, and celebratory occasions. A truly captivating accessory that is sure to draw admiring glances wherever you go.
